r.통화: West African CFA franc · 100 XOF = 225 won
r.경제 체제: Market economy · fish, gold, phosphates, oil and gas starting up
r.한국이 파는 것: Cars 36%, Trucks 21%, Plastics 10%, Machinery, computers 9% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Frozen fish 49%, Aluminum 23%, Copper 13%, Processed meat and fish 4% (2025, share of value)
r.여행경보: Parts of the country: Special advisory · Rest of the country: Exercise caution
r.정치 구도: A presidential system and a democracy where power has changed hands peacefully, without coups.

t.why: All French military bases withdrew in 2025. It has started producing offshore oil and gas.
t.rel: A relatively stable democracy in West Africa. All French military bases withdrew in 2025.
t.know: Its capital, Dakar, is the westernmost city on the African mainland.
t.etext: It sells fish, gold and phosphates, and recently began producing oil and gas. Dakar is West Africa's transport hub.
